There is set to be a slight reduction in the length of Formula 1 races for the 2027 season, the FIA has confirmed.

At a meeting of the F1 Commission in London on Monday, the sport's decision makers agreed to reduce Grand Prix distances from 305km to 290km, which corresponds to a reduction of two to three laps depending on the circuit.
The change is being made because fuel flow rates are being increased next season as part of measures the FIA are introducing to optimise the all-new regulations brought in at the start of 2026.

items.summaryZh: 据The 比赛报道，FIA正在评估对ADUO规则进行修改，计划在2027年实施，旨在让追赶机制在前部更好地发挥作用，同时帮助处于后部的本田。

items.originalTitle: FIA拟调整ADUO规则以助本田，或引发系统大改
items.summaryEn: The FIA is evaluating potential tweaks to the ADUO rules for 2027, aiming to make the catch-up mechanism work better at the front and help Honda at the back, according to The Race.
detailZh: 明年有可能对一级方程式ADUO规则进行全面改革，作为双管齐下策略的一部分，以使追赶机制在前排更好地发挥作用，并帮助后排的本田。
《The 比赛》获悉，FIA正在评估对备受争议的额外开发与升级机会系统在2027年的潜在调整。
人们希望这能避免本赛季困扰该机制的一些头痛问题——同时也有助于实现其最初目标，即成为后排车队的保障网，而不是影响前排竞争的因素。
ADUO最初旨在帮助那些出了问题的制造商有能力恢复。
但这带来了意想不到的后果，也引发了相当大的争议，因为红牛被宣布拥有最好的引擎，尽管它没有赢得过一场比赛。
红牛的挫败感加剧了，因为冠军领跑者梅赛德斯被判定落后足够多，从而有资格在本赛季和下一赛季获得一个开发步骤。
争议点之一是ADUO排名仅基于内燃机的功率输出，而非整个动力单元的性能。
这让F1面临一种局面：被广泛认为拥有最佳性能套件的梅赛德斯被允许带来开发，而红牛却不能，因为其内燃机太强了。
同样已经明确的是，ADUO 系统可能让基准制造商陷入无法改进的困境，因为竞争对手可以选择只开发国际汽联在排名时不测量的部件。
本赛季暴露出的问题进一步推动了国际汽联长期以来的信念，即需要对 ADUO 进行改进。
而最近几周，在阿斯顿·马丁老板 Lawrence Stroll 推动帮助其车队陷入困境的引擎制造商本田获得一些额外援助之后，关于进一步调整的想法加速了。
《The 比赛》获悉，国际汽联目前正在研究 2027 年的潜在变化，届时旨在改善燃油流速的法规调整也将生效。
任何即将进行的修订都将集中在两个主要方面：如何让整个ADUO系统变得更好，以及在其中可以做些什么来为像本田这样陷入困境的制造商提供更多帮助。
虽然关于可以采取哪些措施的分析仍处于早期阶段，但随着各车队于周一齐聚参加F1委员会的下一次会议，推动明年落实改革的势头可能会在本周加速。
在那里，基于最近关于为本田提供额外援助的讨论，ADUO议题很可能会被提出，以了解制造商之间是否就改革达成共识。
这随后可能会启动一个更正式的举措，通过F1动力单元咨询委员会（PUAC）中涉及发动机法规的讨论来修改规则。
国际汽联长期以来一直持这样一种观点：在ADUO实施的第一年，它在很大程度上是一项仍在推进中的工作，始终有改进的空间。
尽管该管理机构拒绝接受红牛对其作为F1标杆引擎的质疑，但国际汽联从未回避过认为相关规则可以改进的想法。
国际汽联单座赛车总监Nikolas Tombazis在夏休前告诉The 比赛：“在我看来，我认为我们的测量已被证明非常准确。
话虽如此，一切都顺利吗？不，因为显然人们并不满意等等。那么我们需要考虑未来的改进吗？是的，我会这么说。”
比赛 获悉，FIA 目前正在研究哪些改动可以改善明年的 ADUO——既帮助陷入困境的制造商，也缓解外界对于领先阵营如何被衡量的担忧。
虽然尚未做出任何决定，但据了解，一系列选项都在讨论之中。
这可能包括改变内燃机功率的测量方式，使其将涡轮尺寸、工作温度以及排气翼等影响输出的外部因素纳入考量。
一种途径可能是根据动力单元的总体性能而非仅内燃机来确定 ADUO 排名，甚至可能有一种更激进的方式来决定哪些制造商可以改进。
奥迪项目负责人马蒂亚·比诺托在今年早些时候提出，更好的做法是根据制造商锦标赛的排名来确定改进的允许额度，而不是对单一部件的动力进行判断。
托姆巴齐斯多次表示，国际汽联的偏好一直是在评判ADUO排名时考虑更多因素。
在谈到与制造商就规则进行的初步讨论时，他说：“我们提出过是否要考虑某些因素，比如涡轮压力、涡轮直径，或者例如增压室温度的工作情况等等。”
“当时动力单元制造商的普遍立场是，我们应该保持简单。”
虽然此前制造商们否决了一套更复杂的测量体系，但如今看到ADUO系统实际运行后，各方看法很可能已大不相同，而且大家对2026年规则如何运作也有了更清晰的认识。
改变的关键在于获得所有汽车制造商的支持，因为任何规则修订都需经过PUAC。
规则调整若要成事，需获得PUAC中六家制造商（梅赛德斯、法拉利、红牛、奥迪、本田和凯迪拉克）里四家的支持。
不过，在试图为本田争取额外帮助的举措推动下，启用新ADUO框架的动力可能会增强。
尽管在年初得到了竞争对手的支持，获得了第一批帮助，但本田在2026年规则实施的第一年仍然举步维艰。
这体现在一揽子措施中，包括本田获得了1900万美元的支出提升——其中1100万美元是增加的额度，另外800万美元实际上是贷款。
但由于其状况并未显著改善，车队老板Stroll加大了施压力度，要求获得额外扶持——阿隆索也加入了寻求帮助的行列。
国际汽联主席Mohammed Ben Sulayem上周在西班牙大奖赛上公开表示，他希望找到办法给予本田一些援助，帮助其拥有更光明的未来，并让Alonso留在F1。
Ben Sulayem 的观点——其他制造商也持同样看法——是，像 Honda 这样的大制造商如此挣扎，对谁都没有好处。
人们明确承认，如果情况不改变，Honda 退出 F1 的风险显而易见。
此事已经向一些制造商提出，早期迹象表明，有人支持对 ADUO 进行调整以再次帮助 Honda。
梅赛德斯 车队负责人 Toto Wolff 表示，他对给予 Honda 更多帮助的想法持开放态度——因为如果所有制造商都具有竞争力，对每个人都更好。
detailEn: An overhaul of Formula 1's ADUO rules is on the cards for next year as part of a twin-pronged attack to make the catch-up mechanism work better at the front and help Honda at the back.
The Race has learned that the FIA is evaluating potential tweaks to the contentious ADUO (Additional Development and Upgrade Opportunities) system for 2027.

It is hoped that this can avoid some of the headaches that have marred it this season - as well as help deliver on its original aim of being a safety net for those at the back rather than something influencing the fight at the front.
ADUO was originally intended as a means of helping manufacturers that had got things wrong have the ability to recover.
But it threw up unintended consequences, as well as causing a fair deal of controversy, when Red Bull was declared as having the best engine despite having not won a race.
Red Bull's frustrations were amplified by the fact that championship leader Mercedes was judged to be enough behind that it qualified for one development step this season and next.
One of the bones of contention was how the ADUO rankings were based only on the power output of the internal combustion engine and not the performance of the overall power unit.

That left F1 facing a situation whereby Mercedes, which is widely acknowledged as having the best performing package, is allowed to bring developments while Red Bull cannot because its ICE is so strong.

It has also become clear that the ADUO system can leave the benchmark manufacturer trapped in being unable to improve, because rivals can choose to only develop components that are not measured by the FIA when it does its rankings.
The issues exposed this season have added impetus to the FIA's long-standing belief that improvements to ADUO are needed.

And thoughts of further tweaks have accelerated in recent weeks off the back of a push by Aston Martin owner Lawrence Stroll to help his team's struggling engine manufacturer Honda get some extra assistance.
The Race has learned that the FIA is now looking into potential changes for 2027, when tweaks to the regulations to improve fuel flow rates are also coming into play.

Any revisions coming will be focused on two main areas: what makes the ADUO system as a whole better and also what can be done within it to offer more assistance to a struggling manufacturer such as Honda.

While analysis of what can be done is still at an early stage, momentum behind getting changes in place for next year could accelerate this week with teams gathering for the next meeting of the F1 Commission on Monday.
There, off the back of recent discussions regarding extra assistance for Honda, the ADUO topic could well get raised to see if there is consensus between manufacturers for change.
That could then set in motion a more formal move to change the rules through discussions in F1's Power Unit Advisory Committee (PUAC) that deals with engine regulations.
The FIA has long been open to the view that in the first year of its implementation, ADUO was very much a work in progress that always had room to be improved.
While the governing body rejects Red Bull's scepticism about it being F1's benchmark engine, the FIA never shied away from thinking that the rules could be improved.
The FIA's single seater director Nikolas Tombazis told The Race before the summer break: "I think our measurement, in my opinion, has proven to be very accurate.
"With that said, has everything worked fine? No, because obviously people are not happy and so on. So do we need to think about improvements in the future? Yes, I would say so."

The Race has learned that the FIA is now studying what changes could work to improve ADUO for next year - both to help struggling manufacturers but also alleviate concerns about how things are measured at the front.
While nothing has been decided yet, it is understood that a range of options are on the table.

This could include changes to the way that the ICE power is measured, so it takes into account elements such as turbo size, operating temperatures and outside factors that influence output like exhaust wings.
One route could be to base the ADUO rankings on the overall power unit performance rather than just the ICE, while there could even be a more radical way of deciding which manufacturers can improve.

Audi project chief Mattia Binotto suggested earlier in the year that it would be better to base allowances for improvement on constructors' championship positions and not a judgement on the power of a single component.
Tombazis has said many times that the FIA's preference was always to take more factors into consideration for judging the ADUO rankings.

Speaking about initial discussions on the rules with manufacturers, he said: "We offered whether we wanted to consider certain things like the turbo pressures, or the turbo diameters, or the operating of the plenum temperature, for example, and such like.
"The universal position by the PU manufacturers back then was that we should keep it simple."

While a more complicated measurement system was rejected by manufacturers before, the views of everyone may well be different now that they have seen the ADUO system in operation, plus everyone has a better idea of how the 2026 regulations are working.
Key to change will be getting support from all the carmakers as any revisions to the regulations would need to go through the PUAC.
For rule tweaks to happen, four out of the six manufacturers (Mercedes, Ferrari, Red Bull, Audi, Honda and Cadillac) that sit on the PUAC would need to support them.
Impetus for getting a new ADUO framework in play could be increased though off the back of moves to try to bring Honda some extra help.
Honda has struggled in the first year of the 2026 rules despite having received a first batch of help at the start of the year following support from rivals.
This manifested itself in a package of measures that included Honda receiving a $19million spending boost - $11m of which was an increased allowance and a further $8m that was effectively a loan.
But with its situation having not improved dramatically, team owner Stroll has increased pressure for an extra leg-up - with Fernando Alonso also joining calls for help.

FIA president Mohammed Ben Sulayem spoke openly at the Spanish Grand Prix last week about his desire to find ways to give Honda some assistance that would help give it a brighter future and keep Alonso in F1.
Ben Sulayem's viewpoint – and it is one shared by other manufacturers – is that nobody stands to benefit from having a major manufacturer like Honda struggling so much.
There is a clear acceptance that if the situation did not change, there would be an obvious risk of Honda pulling out of F1.
The matter has been raised with some manufacturers already, and early indications are that there is support for tweaks to ADUO to help Honda again.
Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff says he is open to the idea of handing Honda more help – because it is better for everyone if all manufacturers were competitive.
keyPointsZh: ADUO全称为Additional Development and Upgrade Opportunities，原意是帮助制造商从错误中恢复。
此次调整旨在避免本赛季出现的部分问题，并回归其作为后部车队安全网的初衷。
keyPointsEn: ADUO stands for Additional Development and Upgrade Opportunities, originally intended to help manufacturers recover from mistakes.
The tweaks aim to avoid some of the headaches that have marred this season and return to its original aim of being a safety net for those at the back.

卡洛斯·塞恩斯建议威廉姆斯青训车手威尔·格林在准备从卡丁车转向单座赛车时承担风险
卡洛斯·塞恩斯敦促威廉姆斯F1青训车手威尔·格林在13岁准备从卡丁车毕业进入单座赛车时，优先寻找极限而非追求稳定性。
格林于2024年12月被宣布为威廉姆斯赛车学院车手，近期成为2026年卡丁车欧洲锦标赛青年组冠军。
在接受这位青少年卡丁车冠军采访时，这位西班牙车手详细讲述了他对青训发展、技术反馈和体能准备的看法。
“不要害怕犯错。与其试图过于保守，不如推得太狠并犯错，”塞恩斯在威廉姆斯YouTube频道的视频中说。“你正处于尽可能多学习的年龄。所以，不要害怕。
“不要害怕犯错，冒太多风险，去超车或做最后一圈的动作，也许太冒险了。我会说那个年龄正是做这些的时候，因为那是你学到最多的时候。
“始终尽量接近极限。显然，不要做任何愚蠢的事情。如果你能避免愚蠢的错误，就避免愚蠢的错误。但要敢于冒险，因为当风险得到回报时，你会感到非常自信，而那就是你的天赋倍增的地方。你不仅有天赋，而且自信。”
这位32岁的车手还回顾了自己从卡丁车的过渡。“我觉得从卡丁车到赛车对我来说很自然。并不觉得奇怪，”他补充道。
“总有一天你会跳进一辆车里。他们会教你如何换挡，如何操作一切。前两圈会很奇怪，但随后你那种无论他们给你什么都要全力推进的本能就会启动，你会找到办法。”
detailEn: Carlos Sainz backs bold approach for Williams junior Will Green's racing future
Carlos Sainz has advised Williams junior Will Green to take risks as he prepares to make the step from karting to single-seater racing
Carlos Sainz has urged Williams Formula 1 junior Will Green to prioritise finding the limits over consistency as the 13-year-old prepares to graduate from karting to single-seaters.
Green was announced as a Williams Racing Academy driver in December 2024 and recently became the 2026 Karting European Championship junior champion.
Speaking in an interview conducted by the teenage karting champion, the Spanish driver detailed his approach to junior racing development, technical feedback and physical preparation.

"Don't be afraid to make mistakes. It's better to push too hard and make mistakes than try and be too conservative," Sainz said in the video on the Williams YouTube channel. "You are at the age where it's important to learn as much as possible. So, don't be scared.

"Don't be afraid to make mistakes, risk too much and go for overtakes or last-lap moves that maybe are too risky. I would say that age is the time to do it because that's when you will learn the most.

"Always try to be as close to the limit as possible. Obviously, don't do anything stupid. If you can avoid stupid mistakes, avoid stupid mistakes. But go and take risks because when they pay off, you feel a lot of confidence, and that's where your talent multiplies. You're not only talented but also confident."
The 32-year-old also reflected on his transition from karting. "I felt that going from karting to cars was quite natural to me. It didn't feel weird," he added.

"You will jump in a car one day. They will teach you how to drive with the gears, with everything. The first two laps will be strange but then your natural instinct of just pushing flat out whatever they give you will kick in and you will find a way."

detailEn: Guenther Steiner predicts Max Verstappen will go winless in 2026 F1 season
Guenther Steiner has predicted Max Verstappen will end the 2026 Formula 1 season without a win

Former Haas Formula 1 team principal Guenther Steiner believes four-time champion Max Verstappen will fail to win a single grand prix during the 2026 F1 season, arguing that Red Bull's package is not competitive enough.

Verstappen currently sits sixth in the standings with 145 points, 147 points behind championship leader Kimi Antonelli. The Dutchman's best results so far this year have been second place at the Austrian, Hungarian and Spanish Grands Prix.
Speaking on The Red Flags Podcast following the Spanish Grand Prix, Steiner was asked during the show's 'Gas or Brake' feature whether Verstappen would finish the 2026 season without a victory.

"Gas, he will not. Mercedes and McLaren are too strong, and it's just the car," the former Haas team chief explained. "He's not good enough. He will be Super Max, he will be on the podium, but I think that's the limit. That's the limit of that car."

In Madrid, Verstappen capitalised when polesitter Norris lost his lead due to an ill-timed virtual safety car and a slow pitstop. With overtaking opportunities almost non-existent on the new circuit, Verstappen held track position ahead of Norris to finish second.
While speaking to Sky Sports after the race, Verstappen discussed his pace disadvantage to McLaren and Mercedes.

"It's just looking at the lap times, we are quite a bit down still," he said. "It's a mix of a lot of things, for sure maybe a little bit of deployment, but also the car itself that we still need to improve on, because when Lando was behind me he was flying. He was a lot faster, but just because of the nature of the track he couldn't get by."
The 15th round of the 2026 season, the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, is set for 24-26 September at the Baku City Circuit.

梅赛德斯F1发展车手Doriane Pin设定了五年目标，希望获得F1发车格上的正赛车手席位。
在近期梅赛德斯“In Convo With Kids”采访中，这位法国车手确认了自己的长期职业目标，并表示相信女性车手能够达到冠军水平。当被问及五年后自己的位置时，Pin直接回答：“在F1。”
“那会很酷。这将为所有想成为F1车手的女孩打开一些大门。”
在赢得2025年F1 Academy冠军后，Pin与这支位于Brackley的车队签约成为发展车手，并于2026年4月在银石成为首位驾驶梅赛德斯F1赛车的女性，测试了2021赛季的W12。
除了F1职责外，这位22岁的车手还担任标致在世界耐力锦标赛和雪铁龙在Formula E的发展车手。她还代表Duqueine Team参加欧洲勒芒系列赛的勒芒原型车2 Pro-Am组别。
Pin热衷于推动赛车行业的多元化和包容性。
“总的来说是多元化，”她在谈到自己会改变世界的一件事时说。“所以在体育内外，我认为我们需要更多多元化。”
“所以为每个人提供更多机会。尤其是我在赛车这样男性主导的运动中的经历。所以如果我们在F1中也有很多女性，那就太好了。”
如果Pin进入F1，她将追随一小群驾驶过现代F1赛车的女性车手。F1 Academy常务董事Susie Wolff曾在2014年为威廉姆斯参加官方自由练习赛，成为22年来首位参加大奖赛周末的女性。
更近一些，阿斯顿·马丁大使Jessica Hawkins于2023年9月在匈牙利赛道完成了AMR21的26圈测试。
detailEn: 2025 F1 Academy champion Doriane Pin sets timeline for Formula 1 race seat
Mercedes F1 development driver Doriane Pin has set her sights on securing a Formula 1 race seat within the next five years
Mercedes Formula 1 development driver Doriane Pin has set a five-year target to secure a race seat on the F1 grid.

Speaking in a recent Mercedes In Convo With Kids interview, the French driver confirmed her long-term career goals and her belief that female drivers can reach the championship. When asked where she sees herself in five years' time, Pin responded directly: "In Formula 1.
"That would be cool. It will open some doors to all the girls that want to be a Formula 1 driver."

After winning the F1 Academy championship in 2025, Pin signed as a development driver for the Brackley outfit and became the first woman to drive a Mercedes F1 car at Silverstone in April 2026, testing the W12 from the 2021 season.

Alongside her F1 duties, the 22-year-old driver serves as a development driver for Peugeot in the World Endurance Championship and Citroën in Formula E. She also competes in the Le Mans Prototype 2 Pro-Am class of the European Le Mans Series for the Duqueine Team.
Pin is passionate about increasing diversity and inclusivity in the motorsport industry.
"Diversity, in general," she said about one thing she would change about the world. "So in sports and outside of sports, I think we need more diversity.
"So more opportunities for everyone. Especially with my experience in a male-dominated sport like motorsport. So it would be good if we had a lot of women also in Formula 1."

Should Pin reach F1, she would follow a small group of female drivers who have driven modern-era F1 machinery. F1 Academy managing director Susie Wolff drove in official free practice sessions for Williams in 2014, becoming the first woman to participate in a grand prix weekend in 22 years.
More recently, Aston Martin ambassador Jessica Hawkins completed a 26-lap test in the AMR21 at the Hungaroring in September 2023.

她同时担任标致WEC和雪铁龙Formula E的发展车手，并参加欧洲勒芒系列赛LMP2 Pro-Am组别。
若Pin进入F1，她将追随少数驾驶过现代F1赛车的女性车手，包括2014年为威廉姆斯参加官方练习赛的Susie Wolff和2023年完成AMR21测试的Jessica Hawkins。

加布里埃尔·博尔托莱托表示，他的经纪人费尔南多·阿隆索在幕后与公开场合一样直率、一样爱讽刺。

奥迪F1车手加布里埃尔·博尔托莱托表示，他的经纪人、两届世界冠军费尔南多·阿隆索在幕后与媒体面前完全一样。
博尔托莱托目前处于他在该赛事的第二个赛季，他于2025年随索伯完成F1首秀，随后奥迪在今年年初正式接管这支瑞士车队。在这位巴西车手逐级晋升的过程中，他一直由阿隆索的A14 Management经纪公司管理。
在参加《The Fast And The Curious》播客节目时，博尔托莱托被问及这位阿斯顿·马丁车手是否有公众看不到的、更私密的一面。
“他在镜头前非常直率。他就是他展现出来的样子。他的优点之一就是不做作。所以，我认为人们知道他是怎样的人，”博尔托莱托解释道。
“我喜欢他很多时候对很多事情都很讽刺，但人们已经知道（这一点），大多数时候他是在讽刺，而且特别好笑。我喜欢这样。我为此笑得很开心。”
这位21岁的车手说，他“喜欢”阿隆索的讽刺，并补充说“相当好笑”。
博尔托莱托加入了A14 Management旗下的一长串车手名单，包括马克西米利安·京特、克莱芒·诺瓦拉克、尼古拉·措洛夫、佩佩·马蒂、塞巴斯蒂安·蒙托亚、克洛伊·钱伯斯、韩岑宇、安德烈斯·卡德纳斯和卡尔·贝内特。
阿隆索曾在2025年将博尔托莱托称为“这一代最好的新秀”，当时博尔托莱托在匈牙利大奖赛中获得第六名，排在第五的阿隆索之后。
“他犯的错误很少，总是施加压力。他（博尔托莱托）是这一代最好的新秀，”阿隆索当时说。“如果他是英国人什么的，开着索伯拿到第六名，明天就会登上所有新闻。他所做的是非凡的。”
在新秀赛季获得车手锦标赛第19名后，博尔托莱托目前以10分位列积分榜第14位。相比之下，他经验丰富的队友尼科·霍肯伯格以7分位列第15位。
detailEn: Gabriel Bortoleto opens up on Fernando Alonso's personality away from F1 cameras
Gabriel Bortoleto says his manager Fernando Alonso is just as straightforward and sarcastic behind the scenes as he appears publicly
Fernando Alonso, Aston Martin Racing, Gabriel Bortoleto, Audi F1 Team
Audi Formula 1 driver Gabriel Bortoleto says his manager, two-time champion Fernando Alonso, is exactly the same behind the scenes as he appears in the media.

Bortoleto is now in his second season in the championship, having made his F1 debut in 2025 with Sauber before Audi formally took over the Swiss team at the start of this year. During his rise through the motorsport ranks, the Brazilian driver has been managed by Alonso's A14 Management agency.
During an appearance on The Fast And The Curious podcast, Bortoleto was asked if there is a different, more private side to the Aston Martin driver that the public does not get to see.
"He's very straightforward when he's in [front of] the cameras. He's like what he shows. One of his qualities is that he doesn't fake it. So, I think people know how he is," Bortoleto explained.
"I love that he's very sarcastic many times, with many stuff, but people already know [that], but most of the time he's being sarcastic, and it's so funny. I love it. I laugh so much about it."
The 21-year-old said that he "likes" Alonso's sarcasm, adding "it's quite funny".

Bortoleto joins a long list of drivers under A14 Management, including Maximilian Guenther, Clement Novalak, Nikola Tsolov, Pepe Marti, Sebastian Montoya, Chloe Chambers, Cenyu Han, Andres Cardenas and Carl Bennett.
Alonso described Bortoleto as "the best rookie of this generation" in 2025 after he finished sixth at the Hungarian Grand Prix behind Alonso in fifth.

"He commits few errors, always putting pressure. He's [Bortoleto] the best rookie of this generation," Alonso said at the time. "If he was English, or something, and finished sixth in a Sauber, he'd be in all the news tomorrow. What he does is exceptional."

After finishing 19th in the drivers' championship in his rookie season, Bortoleto currently sits 14th in the standings with 10 points. By comparison, his experienced team-mate Nico Hulkenberg sits 15th with seven points.

detailZh: Otmar Szafnauer对凯迪拉克“次优”的美英分设架构提出担忧
前阿尔派车队领队Otmar Szafnauer警告称，凯迪拉克的运营架构可能使其无法争夺世界冠军
Valtteri Bottas，凯迪拉克车队，Sergio Perez，凯迪拉克车队
前阿尔派一级方程式车队领队Otmar Szafnauer警告称，凯迪拉克的运营架构并非以赢得冠军为目标。
在经历漫长且高度公开的入局流程后，通用汽车旗下凯迪拉克品牌于2026赛季初作为第11支车队加入F1发车格。
虽然该车队在银石开设了欧洲设施以吸纳这项锦标赛的传统人才库，但其大量设计与模拟工作在美国印第安纳波利斯和南卡罗来纳进行。
在High Performance 比赛播客中与主持人Jake Humphrey交谈时，Szafnauer质疑该车队长期而言将如何现实地以这种架构运作。
“我最近和凯迪拉克执行工程顾问同乘一班飞机，Pat正在与凯迪拉克合作或为其工作，”Szafnauer说。
“凯迪拉克正在印第安纳波利斯建设基地。我对Pat说，‘那是次优的。比如说，如果你拥有和梅赛德斯一样天赋的车手，如果凯迪拉克生产出和梅赛德斯一样性能的动力单元，而且你对车辆动力学、空气动力学、轮胎的理解都和梅赛德斯一样。
“‘唯一的区别是你有一部分设计团队在银石，你的空气动力学人员、一部分设计团队在印第安纳波利斯，你的模拟团队在南卡罗来纳。这是唯一的区别。谁会赢？梅赛德斯。’”
他补充道：“他说，‘只有当你想要赢得世界冠军时，它才是次优的。’所以这就是我的观点。首先，目标是什么。如果目标是让它更像一支美国车队，那么是的，在印第安纳波利斯和南卡罗来纳建设。但如果你的目标是赢得世界冠军，那么你就做一切必要之事去赢得世界冠军。而那并不是。”
自加入F1发车格以来，凯迪拉克一直在努力适应这项锦标赛，同时也在与一些可靠性问题作斗争。目前它以零分在车队积分榜上排名第11位。
detailEn: Otmar Szafnauer raises concern over Cadillac's "suboptimal" split US-UK structure
Former Alpine team principal Otmar Szafnauer has warned that Cadillac’s operational structure could prevent it from challenging for a world championship
Valtteri Bottas, Cadillac Racing, Sergio Perez, Cadillac Racing
Former Alpine Formula 1 team principal Otmar Szafnauer has warned that Cadillac's operational structure is not geared towards winning a championship.
Following a prolonged and highly publicised entry process, General Motors, under its Cadillac brand, joined the F1 grid at the start of the 2026 season as the 11th team.

While the team opened a European facility in Silverstone to tap into the championship's traditional talent pool, a large amount of its design and simulation work takes place in Indianapolis and South Carolina in the United States.
Speaking on the High Performance Racing podcast alongside broadcaster Jake Humphrey, Szafnauer questioned how the team would realistically work with this set-up in the long term.
"I was with Pat Symonds [executive engineering consultant for Cadillac] on a flight recently, and Pat is working with or for Cadillac," Szafnauer said.

"Cadillac is building a base in Indianapolis. And I said to Pat, 'That's suboptimal. If, for example, you have the same talent of drivers that Mercedes has and if Cadillac produces the same performant power unit that Mercedes has and you understand vehicle dynamics, aerodynamics, the tyre as well as Mercedes do.

"'The only difference is you've got some of your design team based in Silverstone and your aero guys, some of your design team based in Indianapolis and your simulation team in South Carolina. It's the only difference. Who's going to win? Mercedes.'"

He added: "He said, 'It's only suboptimal if you want to win the world championship.' So that's my point. First, the objective. If the objective is to make it more of an American team, then yes, build in Indianapolis and in South Carolina. But if your objective is to win the world championship, then you do everything it takes to win the world championship. And that ain't it."

Since joining the F1 grid, Cadillac has worked to adapt to the championship while also battling against some reliability issues. It currently sits 11th in the constructors' standings with zero points.

detailZh: 迈凯伦发布诺里斯超级跑车测试幕后视频
迈凯伦分享了诺里斯驾驶MCL-HY超级跑车完成38圈的画面
迈凯伦发布了兰多·诺里斯近日在葡萄牙进行超级跑车测试的幕后视频。
在上周末于新马德里赛道举行的西班牙大奖赛中获得第三名后，这位2025年F1世界冠军前往波尔蒂芒，测试沃金车队将于明年参加世界耐力锦标赛的2027款MCL-HY。
与迈凯伦赛车CEO扎克·布朗一同抵达后，诺里斯先参加了工程简报会，随后驶上赛道。
“有点不一样，我头顶上有车顶了！”诺里斯在首轮驾驶后说道。“这和我习惯的确实不同，但很好玩。”
这位英国车手在阿尔加维国际赛道完成了38圈，总共驾驶了177公里。
“首先，非常感谢迈凯伦超级跑车团队让我驾驶MCL-HY，”诺里斯在测试日后说道。“他们给了我一个机会去玩一玩、尝试新东西，尤其是在他们为明年忙碌备战的时候，这太棒了。”
“我认为我们也收集了一些有价值的数据，我希望我能带来不同的感受、评论和视角，这对处于关键测试期的车队很有用。”
“对我个人来说，与这支团队合作很酷，尝试新机器也令人兴奋。我已经很多年没有在F1赛车之外做过正式测试了，所以能尝试不同的东西，尤其是仍然作为迈凯伦大家庭的一部分，非常特别。”
“这是有趣的一天，驾驶一辆快车在很酷的赛道上，帮助车队为明年WEC的开始做准备。非常感谢所有参与的人，我迫不及待想在未来再次驾驶这辆车。”
detailEn: McLaren releases behind-the-scenes look at Lando Norris's hypercar test
McLaren has shared footage of Lando Norris completing 38 laps in the MCL-HY hypercar
McLaren has released behind-the-scenes video footage of Lando Norris's recent hypercar test in Portugal.

Following his third-place finish at the Spanish Grand Prix at the new Madring circuit last weekend, the 2025 Formula 1 champion made his way to Portimao to test the Woking outfit's 2027 MCL-HY, which will compete in the World Endurance Championship next year.
After arriving with McLaren Racing CEO Zak Brown, Norris headed to the engineering briefing before getting out on track.
"Bit different, had a roof over my head!" Norris said after his first run. "It's just different to what I'm used to, but good fun."
The Briton completed 38 laps of the Algarve International Circuit and drove a total of 177km.

"First of all, a big thanks to the McLaren Hypercar Team for letting me drive the MCL-HY," Norris said after the test day. "It was great for them to give me a chance to have a bit of fun and try something new, particularly during their busy preparations for next year.

"I think we also collected some valuable data, and I hope I was able to bring a different set of feelings, comments, and perspectives on things, which is useful for the team in this crucial testing period.

"It was cool for me personally to work with this team, and it was exciting to try new machinery too. I've not done a proper test in anything other than an F1 car for years now, so the fact I got to try something different, especially still as part of the McLaren family, was very special.
"It was a fun day in a quick car on a cool track, helping the team prepare for the start of WEC next year. A big thanks to everyone involved, I can't wait to get back in the car in the future."
keyPointsZh: 测试在阿尔加维国际赛道进行，诺里斯与迈凯伦赛车CEO扎克·布朗一同抵达。
该2027款MCL-HY赛车将于明年参加世界耐力锦标赛。
诺里斯表示此次测试为车队收集了宝贵数据，并提供了不同的感受与视角。
keyPointsEn: The test took place at the Algarve International Circuit, with Norris arriving alongside McLaren Racing CEO Zak Brown.
The 2027 MCL-HY will compete in the World Endurance Championship next year.
Norris said the test collected valuable data and brought a different set of feelings and perspectives for the team.

查尔斯·勒克莱尔解释了为何在难以从法拉利2026款F1赛车中榨取最大性能时，他没有尝试复制刘易斯·汉密尔顿的驾驶风格。
随着F1本赛季启用新规，勒克莱尔有时难以驾驭法拉利的SF-26赛车。在去年这位摩纳哥车手明显优于队友汉密尔顿之后，两人在2026年的直接较量变得均衡得多。
以排位赛作为评估纯粹性能的最佳方式来看，汉密尔顿以10比9领先，而勒克莱尔平均快0.023秒——但这一数字因他在巴塞罗那Q3撞车未能做出时间而失真。
这正是勒克莱尔最挣扎的时期。他在加拿大、摩纳哥和加泰罗尼亚三站被队友在排位赛中击败四次，同时仅得16分，而汉密尔顿得到64分，原因是这位28岁车手在《Beyond The 发车区》播客中所描述的“赛车上某种极难应对的东西”。他在主场比赛中一次令人费解的撞车更是雪上加霜，他将此归咎于刹车供应商Brembo。
“当事情不顺利时，就像蒙特利尔和摩纳哥那样，这不仅仅是结果的问题，”勒克莱尔说。
“巴塞罗那的情况好一些。当然，在巴塞罗那的排位赛中，我没有任何借口。那只是我把极限推得太过了。
“当然，我很失望，但那种感觉是存在的。所以当感觉存在时，作为车手你会自信得多。但蒙特利尔和摩纳哥，那种感觉真的不在。就像，无论周日我会取得什么结果，我其实都不太在意。
“对我来说重要的是，当我坐进赛车时，我能获得正确的感觉，我知道我可以通过自然地驾驶、不过度思考来做好我的工作。
“所以当你连续两场比赛事情变得艰难、你找不到那种感觉时，你真的有两个选择。一是尝试通过调校和赛车找到解决办法，让赛车更贴合你的自然驾驶风格。另一个就是改变你的驾驶风格。
“而在我的情况下，我有刘易斯作为队友，他当时状态惊人——而且现在状态依然惊人——所以我知道他的驾驶风格是有效的。它肯定是有效的，”勒克莱尔在意大利大奖赛前继续说道。“所以我仍然有尝试这个选项。我强调‘尝试’这个词，因为试图复制一种驾驶风格总是很困难的。
“这不像‘哦，刘易斯那样做，我也照做’那么简单。刘易斯是一位极具天赋的车手，他有一种属于他自己的自然驾驶风格，在那个特定驾驶风格上他是世界最佳。所以要复制那是非常棘手的。
“我更多地尝试推动去寻找让这辆车更贴合我驾驶风格的方法。我在数据中发现了一些行不通的地方。
“再说一次，在F1中，事情并不总是非黑即白。不是你坐在电脑前，看着数据说，‘哦，这是零点一秒半，我们改一下就能赚回零点一秒’。没那么简单。这是直觉，是感觉，是你可能会想‘好吧，这就是让我在车里不太舒服的地方，如果我改善那种感觉，性能就会到来’的东西。
“所以我在银石的周五晚上发现了两三个问题，在周六排位赛前做了调整，感觉好多了，甚至比巴塞罗那时还要好。从那一刻起，我觉得它朝着正确的方向前进了。”
勒克莱尔在银石的突破让他在英国大奖赛排位赛中位列头排，落后梅赛德斯的基米·安东内利0.175秒，领先汉密尔顿0.172秒。这位法拉利车手在起步时取得领先，并统治了比赛，赢得了他自2024年以来的首场胜利。
据了解，改用Carbone Industrie刹车盘对勒克莱尔状态的回升有所贡献，而这并不是回到他在墨尔本赛季揭幕战时的那种感觉——当时他取得了令人鼓舞的领奖台成绩。
“赛车在不断变化，所以我不可能真正回到墨尔本时的那种感觉。它在不断进化，”勒克莱尔澄清道。
“但我的目标是坐进赛车时不过度思考。当你过度思考时，你知道你在浪费时间，因为我们的运动很大程度上不是对赛车上发生的事情做出反应。更多的是预判，感觉赛车是你的。我的意思是，进入弯道时，我需要确切知道赛车会如何表现，这样我就不必过度思考。”
自银石获胜以来的最近六站中，勒克莱尔是第三高得分手，得到88分，而安东内利得到121分，兰多·诺里斯得到107分；他的记录仅因在蒙扎早早撞车而受损，因为他在其他每场比赛中都进入了前五。
与此同时，汉密尔顿在这段时间仅得到66分，尽管他在马德里站的比赛中因刹车问题被淘汰。
detailEn: Why Charles Leclerc didn’t copy Lewis Hamilton’s driving style amid F1 2026 struggle
Leclerc has, at times, struggled with F1’s new machinery – but emulating Hamilton’s driving style never was a viable option for him
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari
Charles Leclerc has explained why he refrained from trying to copy Lewis Hamilton’s driving style when extracting the most out of Ferrari’s 2026 Formula 1 car was tricky.

As Formula 1 switched to new regulations for this season, Leclerc sometimes struggled with the Scuderia’s SF-26. After the Monegasque noticeably outperformed team-mate Hamilton last year, their head-to-head has been a lot more balanced in 2026.

Looking at qualifying as the best way to evaluate pure performance, Hamilton is up 10-9, while Leclerc has been 0.023s faster on average – but that figure is skewed by the fact he didn’t set a time when he crashed out of Q3 at Barcelona.

This was during the period where Leclerc struggled the most. He was outqualified four times across the Canadian, Monaco and Catalan rounds, while scoring just 16 points to Hamilton’s 64, due to what the 28-year-old described as “something that was extremely difficult to deal with on the car” in the Beyond The Grid podcast. This was compounded by a puzzling crash in his home race, which he blamed on brake supplier Brembo.
“When things don't go well, like it did in Montreal and Monaco, it's not only about the results,” Leclerc said.
“For Barcelona, it was better. And Barcelona, of course, in qualifying, I have no excuses. That's just me pushing the limit too much and too far.

“Of course, I was disappointed, but the feeling was there. So when the feeling is there, you are a lot more confident as a driver. But Montreal and Monaco, the feeling was really not there. Like, whatever the result I will have done on the Sunday, I didn't really care about this.
“What's important for me is that when I get into the car, I get the right feeling and I know that I can do my job properly by driving just naturally and not overthinking things.

“And so when you've got two races consecutive where things are getting tough and you don't have the feeling, you've got two options, really. One is to try and find a way around with the set-up and with the car and trying to fit your natural driving style more. The other is just change your driving style.

“And in my case, I have Lewis as a team-mate, who was having incredible form – and who is in incredible form – so I knew that his driving style was working. Surely it was working,” Leclerc continued, speaking ahead of the Italian Grand Prix. “So I still had that option on trying. And I push on the word ‘trying’ because it's always difficult to try and reproduce a driving style.

“It's not as easy as, ‘Oh, Lewis is doing that, I'll just do the same’. Lewis is an incredibly talented driver and has a natural driving style that is his and he's the best in the world for that particular driving style. And so to reproduce that is very tricky.
“I tried to push more into trying to find ways to have this car a bit more fitted to my driving style. And I found a few things in the data that were just not working.

“Again, in Formula 1, it's not always black and white. It's not like you sit in front of your computer, look at the data and say, ‘Oh, this is one tenth and a half of a second, let's change that and we'll gain one tenth’. It's not as easy as that. It's intuition, it's feeling, it's things that you might think, ‘Okay, this is what makes me a bit less comfortable in the car, and if I improve that feeling, then performance will come’.

“And so I saw two, three things on the Friday night in Silverstone, changed those for the Saturday in qualifying, and the feeling was a lot better and even better than it was in Barcelona. And from that moment, I felt it went towards the right direction.”

Leclerc’s Silverstone breakthrough saw him qualify on the front row for the British Grand Prix, 0.175s down on Mercedes’ Kimi Antonelli and 0.172s ahead of Hamilton. The Ferrari racer took the lead at the start and dominated the race to clinch his first victory since 2024.

A switch to Carbone Industrie brake discs is understood to have contributed to Leclerc’s upturn in form, which wasn’t a case of returning to the feeling he had at the Melbourne season opener, where he had claimed an encouraging podium finish.
“The car is constantly changing, so it's not like I can really go back to that feeling I had in Melbourne. It's evolving,” Leclerc clarified.

“But my goal is to get into the car and not overthink. When you overthink, you know that you are losing time on the table because our sport is not a lot about reacting on what's happening on the car. It's more about anticipating and feeling the car yours. I mean, getting into a corner, I need to know exactly the way the car will behave so I don't have to overthink about things.”

Leclerc has been the third-highest scorer since over the latest six rounds, going back to his Silverstone win, with 88 points to Antonelli’s 121 and Lando Norris’ 107; his record is tarnished by his early Monza crash only, as he finished every other race in the top five.
Meanwhile, Hamilton has scored just 66 over that period, though he was taken out of the Madring race by brake issues.

detailZh: 梅赛德斯与阿斯顿马丁在慈善足球赛中正面交锋：以下是比赛结果
阿斯顿马丁和梅赛德斯的工作人员在年度慈善足球赛中正面交锋
费尔南多·阿隆索，阿斯顿马丁车队，安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯
阿斯顿马丁和梅赛德斯F1车队的工作人员在年度慈善足球赛中正面交锋，为两家慈善机构筹集资金。
这场比赛在布拉克利镇足球俱乐部的圣詹姆斯公园举行，自2022年起每年举办，由这两支相邻的北安普敦郡车队对阵，为当地及心理健康慈善机构募集资金。
银石车队在社交媒体上分享了活动动态，确认其选择的慈善机构是Movember，该机构关注男性心理健康与自杀预防、前列腺癌和睾丸癌。
梅赛德斯所得收益的一部分捐给了儿童临终关怀机构Helen & Douglas House，该机构“帮助家庭应对照顾身患绝症的婴儿或儿童的挑战”。
梅赛德斯以3-1赢得男子比赛，阿斯顿马丁以2-1赢得女子比赛。
“这是让两支车队在场外团结起来的一种绝佳方式，”梅赛德斯F1慈善与社区外联负责人伊莫金·泰特告诉BBC北安普敦电台。
“不出所料，我们很多人都非常非常好胜，所以还有什么比这更好的方式让我们的团队成员聚在一起呢？”
她补充说：“利用我们的资源回馈社会、做善事非常重要。这只是我们回馈这个地区的一种方式。”
这场比赛是在全新的马德里赛道赛道举行的西班牙大奖赛之后进行的。梅赛德斯凭借当前积分榜领跑者基米·安东内利赢得了本赛季第10场大奖赛胜利，而阿斯顿马丁则继续挣扎。费尔南多·阿隆索获得第17名，他的队友兰斯·斯特罗尔退赛。
梅赛德斯以503分领跑车队积分榜，法拉利以358分紧随其后，迈凯伦以306分位列第三。阿斯顿马丁整个赛季都表现挣扎，尽管在匈牙利大奖赛引入了B版赛车并在随后的比赛中进一步升级了动力单元，但尚未看到性能的大幅提升。它目前以3分排在积分榜第10位。
detailEn: Mercedes and Aston Martin go head-to-head in charity football match: Here are the results
Aston Martin and Mercedes staff went head-to-head in their annual charity football match
Fernando Alonso, Aston Martin Racing, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes
Staff from the Aston Martin and Mercedes Formula 1 teams have gone head-to-head in the annual charity football match to raise funds for two charities.

The match, which is hosted at Brackley Town Football Club's St James Park and has been held since 2022, pits the neighbouring Northamptonshire squads against one another to raise funds for local and mental health charities.

The Silverstone outfit shared updates from the event on social media, confirming that its chosen charity was Movember, which focuses on men's mental health and suicide prevention, prostate cancer and testicular cancer.
Mercedes' portion of the proceeds went to children's hospice Helen & Douglas House, which "helps families cope with the challenges of looking after a terminally ill baby or child".
Mercedes won the men's match 3-1 and Aston Martin won the women's match 2-1.
"It's a fantastic way to bring both teams together off-track," Mercedes F1 charity and community outreach lead Imogen Tait told BBC Radio Northampton.
"Unsurprisingly, a lot of us are very, very competitive, so what better way than to bring our team members together?"
She added: "It is so important that we use our resources to give back and to do good. This is just one way that we can give back to this area."

The match followed the Spanish Grand Prix at the brand-new Madring circuit. While Mercedes claimed its 10th grand prix victory of the season with current championship leader Kimi Antonelli, Aston Martin continued to struggle. Fernando Alonso finished 17th and his team-mate Lance Stroll retired.

Mercedes leads the constructors' standings with 503 points, followed by Ferrari with 358 points and McLaren with 306 points. Aston Martin has struggled all season and while it introduced a B-spec car at the Hungarian Grand Prix and further power unit upgrades in the following races, it is yet to see a major boost in performance. It currently sits 10th in the standings with three points.

detailZh: 红牛承认，维斯塔普恩赛车出现的神秘问题在2027年之前无法完全解决
洛朗·梅基耶斯坦言，红牛确实在F1比赛周末中遭遇“赛车性能退化”问题。这支位于米尔顿凯恩斯的车队已经吸取了若干教训，不过这个问题在今年这款赛车上无法彻底修复
在本赛季的多个比赛周末中，维斯塔普恩抱怨红牛赛车在一场练习赛或正式比赛中会越跑越差。这通常发生在后轴上，包括蒙扎的排位赛期间，当时维斯塔普恩称小红牛22“是一辆用纸做的赛车”。
值得注意的是，这位四届世界冠军还补充说，他多年来一直在内部反映这个问题。据维斯塔普恩所说，红牛在一场比赛中遭遇赛车性能退化的困扰已经持续了多个赛季，考虑到2026年的赛车在技术规则全面改革后完全是全新的车型，这一点尤其令人惊讶。
这就引出了一个问题：为什么这个问题如此顽固，以及红牛现在是否终于明白了背后的原因。
当Motorsport.com向红牛车队领队洛朗·梅基斯提出这些问题时，这位法国人回答说："我认为我们不会解释问题是什么以及如何解决它。但我认为维斯塔潘说得对，赛车性能确实存在一种在单节练习和整场比赛过程中逐渐衰退的因素。"
"他说这不是一个新问题也是对的。我们并没有对此置之不理。我们一直在尝试用不同的方式来解决这个问题。"
"显然，我认为这是一个复杂的问题。否则我们早就把它彻底搞清楚了。但每个人对此都很有建设性，我们正在努力一步步前进，以便最终把它彻底搞明白。"
维斯塔潘在蒙扎表示，红牛的赛车“像纸做的”，此前他在排位赛中遭遇了“赛车性能衰退”
至于那些小的改进，梅基斯表示，在蒙扎的周六——也就是维斯塔潘表达不满的那一天——车队吸取了一些教训，而红牛在马德里尝试将这些教训付诸实践。这个问题在F1首次造访马德里金环赛道时并未出现，或者至少没有达到同样的程度。
“我们在周末在这方面取得了几个积极的进展，”梅基斯说，“它永远不会是完整的解决方案，但我们确实在痛苦中加深了理解。我们还没有在赛车上拿出所有的解决方法，但我相信我们的方向是对的。这不会很快实现，所以这可能会一直持续到明年。”
在这样说的同时，梅基斯也承认了维斯塔潘早些时候已经暗示过的情况：有些问题根本无法在本赛季解决，需要为2027年对设计和底盘进行更大的改动。
红牛在今年剩余的时间里所能做的事情有限，部分原因是预算帽（预算上限）到某个时点会发挥作用，而且幕后重心已经转向2027年，但也因为小红牛22赛车上有些改动根本无法实现。
如果维斯塔潘本赛季拿不下一场大奖赛胜利，这将是自2015年以来第一个没有分站冠军的年份。
因此，梅基斯承认，在今年剩下的比赛中，这个问题可能会更频繁地出现，尽管他不愿进一步详细说明背后的具体原因。
"听着，我不打算在这里透露更多细节。但正如我所说，确实存在这样的情况：赛车的某些性能方面有时无法保持在最佳水平。而那可是相当可观的单圈时间损失。"
"所以，这是我们[需要解决的问题]。毫无疑问，我们所有人都在努力为未来改进这一点。"
对于今年来说，维斯塔潘已经很清楚自己几乎没有可以争夺的东西了。这位荷兰车手早在之前就承认，自己不是争夺总冠军的竞争者，只能寄希望于赢下一场比赛的胜利。
如果他未能做到这一点，那将是自2015年以来的第一次，当时维斯塔潘还效力于红牛二队（Toro Rosso）——也就是现在的小红牛车队。自从2016年5月升入红牛车队以来，这位荷兰车手每年都至少赢得一场大奖赛。
detailEn: Red Bull admits Max Verstappen's mysterious car issue cannot be fully fixed until 2027

Laurent Mekies acknowledges that Red Bull does indeed suffer from 'car degradation' during F1 weekends. The Milton Keynes-based team has learned several lessons, although the issue cannot be fully fixed with this year's car

During several weekends this Formula 1 season, Verstappen has complained that the Red Bull car gets worse over the course of a session or race. It usually happens at the rear axle, including during qualifying at Monza, where Verstappen called the RB22 "a car made of paper".

Notably, the four-time world champion added that he has been complaining about this internally for years. According to Verstappen, Red Bull has been struggling with car degradation during a session for multiple seasons, which is remarkable given that the 2026 car is completely new following the overhaul of the technical regulations.
It raises the question of why the problem is so persistent and whether Red Bull now finally understands what is behind it.

When Motorsport.com puts those questions to Red Bull team principal Laurent Mekies, the Frenchman replies: "I don't think we are going to explain what it is and how we are going to fix it. But I think Max is right [in saying] that there is an element of car performance degradation that is happening through a session and through a race.
"He's also right in saying that it's not a new issue. We are not sleeping on it. We have been trying to tackle that in different ways.

"Obviously, I consider it a complex issue. Otherwise, we would get to the bottom of it. But everyone is very constructive about it and we are trying to make small steps at the time to be able to finally get to the bottom of it."
Verstappen said at Monza that the Red Bull car is “made of paper” after he suffered from “car degradation” during qualifying

As for those small steps, Mekies says several lessons were learned on the Saturday in Monza, when Verstappen voiced his frustration, and Red Bull tried to put those lessons into practice in Madrid. The problem did not occur during F1’s first visit to the Madring, or at least not to the same extent.

"We had a couple of positive steps in that regard this weekend", Mekies said."It will never be the full picture, but we certainly have, through pain, made progress into our understanding. We don't have all the solutions on the car yet, but I trust that we are in the right way. It will not be fast, so it's something that will probably take us through next year."
In doing so, Mekies acknowledges what Verstappen had already hinted at earlier: some problems simply cannot be fixed this season and require bigger changes to the design and chassis for 2027.

The fact that Red Bull is limited in what it can do for the remainder of this year is partly because the budget cap will come into play at some point and because the focus behind the scenes has already shifted to 2027, but also because certain changes simply cannot be made to the RB22.
If Verstappen does not win a Grand Prix this season, it will be the first year since 2015 without a race win
Mekies therefore acknowledges that the issue could occur more often in the remaining races this year, although he does not want to go into further detail about exactly what is behind it.

"Look, I'm not going to give any more details here. But as I said, it's true that there are some aspects of the car performance that sometimes don't stay at the optimum level. And that’s serious lap time.
"So, it's something we [need to get on top of]. There is no doubt that we have everyone trying to improve that for the future."
For this year, Verstappen already knows that there is little left for him to fight for. The Dutchman acknowledged early on that he is not a factor in the title fight and can only hope for a race win.

Should he fail to achieve that, it would be the first time since 2015, when Verstappen was still driving for Toro Rosso – now Racing Bulls. Since his promotion to Red Bull in May 2016, the Dutchman has won at least one Grand Prix every year.
